name: Budget Coach Demo | Pin Tags Message (run once)

parameters.text:
📌 Agent tags (100% reliable routing)

Add one tag to a message and it goes to that agent, whatever the wording:
#budget — family money: expenses, budgets, spending summaries
#subscriptions — subscriptions and recurring payments, renewals, cancelling

Examples: "#budget coffee 18 zl"  ·  "how much do I spend on subscriptions? #subscriptions"

↩️ Reply to a message (swipe left on it) to continue that conversation, any time:
• reply to an agent's message → it goes to that agent
• reply "yes" or "try again" to a message ending with ➡️ #agent → it goes there

Without replying:
• "yes" or "try again" right after a ➡️ #agent line → it goes there
• only the tag, or "#budget try again" → your last request goes to that agent

parameters.content:
# Budget Coach Demo | Pin Tags Message (run once)

One-time utility, not part of the running system. Run it manually once, AFTER "WF1" with the tag routing is live on the same n8n, to put the list of agent tags and how replies work in your chat with the bot and pin it. Running it again sends and pins a new copy (unpin the old one by hand).
No AI. Standalone. Errors: linked to "Error Handling | Main — Error Handler".

## Send and pin

Triggered by: Run Once (manual).

1. Send Tags Message sends the tag list, examples and how replies and "yes" work to chat YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
2. Pin Tags Message pins that message (without a notification).
